notes:
Summary: Elmwood is a mid-sized maritime logistics operator exploring LLMs for operational chat and document search. Heavy emphasis on low-latency (p95 ~150ms for agent replies) and strict audit/data residency for export control logs. Security: strong preference for SSO + KMS; requested SOC2 + client-side key options. 

Engagement notes (shorthand):
- POC ran against hosted API, good perf but procurement wanted minimal vendor overhead.
- Security team: worried about vendor approval timeline for Private deploy; flagged legal review as a blocker.
- Line-of-business (ops) champion enthusiastic, but IT/legal lacked bandwidth to push enterprise onboarding.
- Quote from CTO on final call: "We need something we can sign up and run this week — brand and simplicity win."
- Competitor angle: they cited existing internal experiments with OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs; procurement favored the established brand and lower friction.
- Next: closed-lost to OpenAI direct APIs; outreach cadence set to 90 days to check service maturity and revisit private deployment options.

Stated technical reqs: chat + retrieval, embeddings for search, optional reranking. Wants model family with strong summarization. Careful on cost — prefers predictable token economics.
